parsed.note_claim: NYC's First Lady is Rama Duwaji, not Mara Juwani.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Rama Sawaf Duwaji [ a ] (born June 30, 1997) is an American animator, illustrator, and ceramist . As the wife of Mayor Zohran Mamdani , she has been the first lady of New York City since January 2026 .
parsed.reason: The Wikipedia article explicitly identifies Rama Duwaji as the First Lady of New York City, confirming the name correction in the note.
